scope: Rerun of the two cases that failed or used the wrong evidence path in local.engineering.interruption.20261024, after the fixes in this commit (qualifier reads journals with full sharing; a global library checkpoint below its admitted directory is matched). change_restore killed after 'restoring' was journaled (pre-recovery save/archive phase) -> released: original project unchanged (fresh fingerprint equals the journal's afterFingerprint), checkpoint archive unchanged, recovery destination without content, journal and input unchanged. library_create_master_copy apply killed while 'applying' (project and global-library checkpoints) -> released: project fingerprint plus project-library revision equal the retrieved project checkpoint, global library revision equals the retrieved library checkpoint. Journals unchanged by reconciliation; no mutation re-dispatched.
limitations: Interruption is process termination of the worker and its owned TIA; each case ran once and where the kill landed inside a phase is timing-dependent.
Library revision covers library structure, type versions and master copies, not unexposed object document content.
